body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2010') -- <Visual News> Midland(www.midlandaudio.com) showcased its sports action video camera 'XTC-100' during CES 2010, which can easily mount anywhere on a motorcycle helmet or a ski goggle. It will be launched in April.
< AVING Las Vegas team is on-site bringing readers the latest product CES2010 from the show floor, covering the press conferences >
